dose_adult.indication: Transtorno depressivo maior (cápsula de liberação prolongada)
dose_adult.note: Alguns pacientes podem começar com 37,5 mg/dia por 4 a 7 dias (seção 2.2). Reduzir a dose diária total na insuficiência hepática (50% ou mais) e na renal (25% a 50%, ou 50% ou mais se grave ou em hemodiálise) (seções 2.8 e 2.9).

cite.quote: For most patients, the recommended starting dose for Effexor XR is 75 mg per day, administered in a single dose.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "Patients not responding to the initial 75 mg per day dose may benefit from dose increases to a maximum of 225 mg per day."

cite.locator: Boxed warning: Suicidal thoughts and behaviors
cite.quote: Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in pediatric and young adult patients in short-term studies.

facts.note: Seção 4 (Contraindications): "taking, or within 14 days of stopping, MAOIs (including the MAOIs linezolid and intravenous methylene blue) because of the risk of serotonin syndrome"

cite.quote: Serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs), including Effexor XR, can precipitate serotonin syndrome, a potentially life-threatening condition.
In controlled trials, there were dose-related increases in systolic and diastolic blood pressure, as well as cases of sustained hypertension
cite.note: Mesma seção: "Cases of elevated blood pressure requiring immediate treatment have been reported with Effexor XR."

cite.quote: Drugs that interfere with serotonin reuptake inhibition, including Effexor XR, may increase the risk of bleeding events, ranging from ecchymoses, hematomas, epistaxis, petechiae, and gastrointestinal hemorrhage to life-threatening hemorrhage.

The pupillary dilation that occurs following use of many antidepressant drugs including Effexor XR may trigger an angle closure attack in a patient with anatomically narrow angles who does not have a patent iridectomy.

cite.locator: seção 5.6 Activation of Mania or Hypomania
cite.quote: In patients with bipolar disorder, treating a depressive episode with Effexor XR or another antidepressant may precipitate a mixed/manic episode.

Abrupt discontinuation or dose reduction of venlafaxine at various doses has been found to be associated with the appearance of new symptoms, the frequency of which increased with increased dose level and with longer duration of treatment.
Effexor XR should be prescribed with caution in patients with a seizure disorder.
Hyponatremia can occur as a result of treatment with SNRIs, including Effexor XR.
Use of SNRIs, including Effexor XR, may cause symptoms of sexual dysfunction

facts.note: A bula fala em inibidores da "CYP3A" e só sugere considerar redução de dose; não traz orientação para indutores.

cite.locator: seção 7.1 Drugs Having Clinically Important Interactions with Effexor XR
cite.quote: Concomitant use of a CYP3A inhibitor increases the C max and AUC of venlafaxine and O-desmethylvenlafaxine (ODV) [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3) ] , which may increase the risk of toxicity of Effexor XR. Intervention Consider reducing the dose of Effexor XR.

cite.locator: seção 2.9 Dosage Recommendations for Patients with Renal Impairment
cite.quote: Reduce the Effexor XR total daily dose by 25% to 50% in patients with mild (CLcr 60-89 mL/min) or moderate (CLcr 30-59 mL/min) renal impairment.
